_note: Virtual-retreat MCP tools (2026-10-20 extension pack). core.mjs TOOLS shape.

tools.description: Begin a virtual retreat: pick a programme, get its timetable with talk slots filled from full talks, the centre rules to acknowledge, and a start time. Returns the day-1 schedule; the timer client drives it.
tools.name: start_retreat
tools.resolver: programme + timetable + MMR talk fill (full talks only) + rules + day-1 blocks
tools.title: Start a retreat

tools.description: Today's slice of an active virtual retreat: blocks with times, the talk for this evening, and any teacher-prompt cards. Stateless: pass day number and programme.
tools.name: retreat_today
tools.resolver: timetable day slice + talk slot fill + interview-prompt cards with contacts
tools.title: Retreat today
